name: Gate
author: andreisugu@gmail.com
description: Gate is an extensible, high-performance Minecraft proxy server written in Go. It provides multi-server routing, native GeyserLite Bedrock cross-play, player transfers, Connect network integration, and OpenTelemetry observability with ultra-low memory and CPU footprint.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Gate Prebuilt or Self-Building Installation Script
# Server: Gate (Minecraft proxy written in Go)
# Repository: https://github.com/minekube/gate

set -eux

BUILD_SRC="${BUILD_FROM_SOURCE:-0}"
PLUGINS="${GATE_PLUGINS:-}"
VERSION="${GATE_VERSION:-latest}"
DOWNLOAD_LINK="${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}"
BINARY_NAME="${SERVER_BINARY:-gate}"
BUILD_URL="${BUILD_SCRIPT_URL:-https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andreisugu/gate-plugin-builder/refs/heads/main/build.sh}"

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Mode A: Build from source with build.sh engine (when requested or plugins are configured)
if [ "$BUILD_SRC" = "1" ] || [ -n "$PLUGINS" ] || [ -f "/mnt/server/plugins.txt" ]; then
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "  🔨 Building Gate Proxy + Extensions via build.sh"
    echo "============================================================"

    if command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        apk add --no-cache curl jq ca-certificates git go bash
    elif command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl jq ca-certificates git golang-go bash
    fi

    export GOPROXY="${GOPROXY:-https://proxy.golang.org,direct}"
    export GOTOOLCHAIN="${GOTOOLCHAIN:-auto}"

    # Use /mnt/server (disk storage) rather than /tmp (which is tmpfs RAM in containers)
    BUILD_DIR="/mnt/server/.build_tmp"
    rm -rf "$BUILD_DIR"
    mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR"
    cd "$BUILD_DIR"

    export GOTMPDIR="$BUILD_DIR/gotmp"
    export GOCACHE="$BUILD_DIR/gocache"
    mkdir -p "$GOTMPDIR" "$GOCACHE"

    # Copy plugins.txt manifest if present on server
    if [ -f "/mnt/server/plugins.txt" ]; then
        cp -f "/mnt/server/plugins.txt" ./plugins.txt
    fi

    # Fetch builder engine script
    if [ -f "/mnt/server/build.sh" ]; then
        echo "Using local /mnt/server/build.sh builder engine..."
        cp -f "/mnt/server/build.sh" ./build.sh
    else
        echo "Fetching build engine from: $BUILD_URL"
        curl -sSL -f -o ./build.sh "$BUILD_URL" || {
            echo "Fallback: fetching builder from minekube/gate-plugin-template..."
            curl -sSL -f -o ./build.sh "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/minekube/gate-plugin-template/main/build.sh"
        }
    fi

    chmod +x ./build.sh

    # Execute build engine with low-ram safeguard
    OUTPUT_BINARY="/mnt/server/${BINARY_NAME}" \
    GATE_VERSION="${VERSION}" \
    GATE_PLUGINS="${PLUGINS}" \
    LOW_RAM=1 \
    bash ./build.sh --low-ram

    cd /mnt/server
    rm -rf "$BUILD_DIR"

# Mode B: Download official prebuilt release binary
else
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "  ⚡ Downloading Prebuilt Gate Release"
    echo "============================================================"

    if command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        apk add --no-cache curl jq ca-certificates
    elif command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl jq ca-certificates
    fi

    ARCH="amd64"
    case "$(uname -m)" in
        x86_64) ARCH="amd64" ;;
        aarch64|arm64) ARCH="arm64" ;;
        i386|i686) ARCH="386" ;;
        *) ARCH="amd64" ;;
    esac

    GITHUB_PACKAGE="minekube/gate"

    if [ -n "$DOWNLOAD_LINK" ]; then
        FINAL_URL="$DOWNLOAD_LINK"
    elif [ -z "$VERSION" ] || [ "$VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
        LATEST_TAG=$(curl -sSL "https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_PACKAGE/releases/latest" | (jq -r '.tag_name // empty' 2>/dev/null || grep -o '"tag_name": *"[^"]*"' | head -n 1 | cut -d '"' -f 4))
        if [ -z "$LATEST_TAG" ]; then
            LATEST_TAG="v0.71.3"
        fi
        VERSION_NUM=$(echo "$LATEST_TAG" | sed "s/^v//")
        FINAL_URL="https://github.com/$GITHUB_PACKAGE/releases/download/${LATEST_TAG}/gate_${VERSION_NUM}_linux_${ARCH}"
    else
        VERSION_NUM=$(echo "$VERSION" | sed "s/^v//")
        TAG="v${VERSION_NUM}"
        FINAL_URL="https://github.com/$GITHUB_PACKAGE/releases/download/${TAG}/gate_${VERSION_NUM}_linux_${ARCH}"
    fi

    echo "Downloading Gate binary from: $FINAL_URL"
    curl -sSL -L -f -o "${BINARY_NAME}.tmp" "$FINAL_URL"

    if [ ! -s "${BINARY_NAME}.tmp" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: Downloaded binary is empty or missing!"
        exit 1
    fi

    chmod +x "${BINARY_NAME}.tmp"
    mv -f "${BINARY_NAME}.tmp" "$BINARY_NAME"
fi

chmod +x "/mnt/server/$BINARY_NAME"

# If config.yml already exists, preserve it; otherwise create initial default config
if [ -f "config.yml" ]; then
    echo "Existing configuration detected (config.yml). Preserving existing settings and data."
else
    echo "Fresh installation detected. Creating default configuration file (config.yml)..."
    cat << 'CONFIG_EOF' > config.yml
# Gate proxy configuration for Minecraft Java Edition
config:
  # The bind address to listen for Minecraft client connections.
  bind: 0.0.0.0:25565
  # Whether to use the proxy in online (authenticate players with Mojang API) or offline mode (not recommended).
  onlineMode: true
  # Registers servers with the proxy by giving the address of backend server a custom reference name.
  servers:
    # Server name: server address
    server1: localhost:25566
    server2: localhost:25567
    server3: localhost:25568
    server4: localhost:25569
  # The list of servers to try (ordered) to connect a player to
  # upon login or fallback when a player is kicked from a server.
  try:
    - server1
    - server2
    - server3
    - server4
  # Configure the response for server list pings.
  status:
    # The message of the day in legacy '§' format or modern text component '{"text":"...", ...}' json.
    motd: |
      §bA Gate Proxy
      §bVisit ➞ §fgithub.com/minekube/gate
    # The maximum players shown (is not the actual player limit!).
    showMaxPlayers: 1000
    # Whether to log ping requests in the console.
    logPingRequests: false
    # Whether the proxy should present itself as Forge/FML-compatible server.
    announceForge: false
  # Allows players transferred from other hosts via the
  # Transfer packet (Minecraft 1.20.5) to be received.
  # Default: false
  acceptTransfers: false
  # Whether the proxy should support bungee plugin channels.
  # (Disable this if your backend servers are untrusted.)
  bungeePluginChannelEnabled: true
  # Whether to register builtin commands on proxy start.
  # Default: true
  builtinCommands: true
  # Whether players require permissions to
  # execute a builtin proxy command like /server.
  # Ignore this if `builtinCommands` is set to false.
  # (This should be set to true in production environments.)
  # Default: false
  requireBuiltinCommandPermissions: false
CONFIG_EOF
fi

echo "Installation complete for Gate ($BINARY_NAME)."

variables.name: Build From Source
variables.description:
Compile Gate directly in the container using build.sh. Automatically enables custom plugin bundling.
1 -> Build from source (Default when plugins are specified)
0 -> Download official prebuilt release binary

variables.name: Gate Go Plugins (List or URLs)
variables.description:
List of Go plugins or Git URLs to bundle (comma, space, or newline separated).
Supports Go module paths (e.g. github.com/andreisugu/gate-hybridforwarding), HTTPS/SSH Git URLs (e.g. https://github.com/user/plugin.git), and pinned versions (@v1.0.0).
If populated, Build From Source is automatically triggered.

variables.name: Gate Version
variables.description:
The version tag of Gate to download or build (defaults to latest, or specify a tag like v0.71.3).
Scope: installation

variables.name: Builder Script URL
variables.description: Remote URL to fetch the build.sh builder engine from when compiling from source.

variables.name: Download URL
variables.description:
Direct URL to download the prebuilt Gate binary from (only used when Build From Source = 0 and no plugins specified).
Scope: installation

variables.name: Server Executable Binary
variables.description:
The name of the executable binary saved and run on the server.
Scope: installation / startup

variables.name: Debug Mode
variables.description:
Enable debug mode and highest log verbosity.
0 -> disabled (default)
1 -> enabled

variables.name: Logging Verbosity
variables.description: The higher the verbosity the more logs are shown (default: 0).

variables.name: Disable Config Auto Reload
variables.description:
Whether to disable automatic config file reloading when config.yml is modified.
0 -> auto reload enabled (default)
1 -> auto reload disabled
